name: Daal Mash
description: Comforting Pakistani daal mash made with split urad lentils, tomatoes, ginger and a fragrant cumin-garlic tarka.
method: Wash the mash dal well and soak it for 30 minutes.
Cook the dal with fresh water, turmeric and salt until tender but not completely mushy.
In a separate pan, heat oil and fry cumin, garlic and onion until golden.
Add tomatoes, red chili and green chilies and cook until the masala softens.
Stir the cooked dal into the masala and simmer until thick and creamy.
Finish with garam masala, julienned ginger and fresh coriander.
